notes.title: UNDERCAT - release!
notes.notes:
Yaaay!
We've been working hard for several years to reach this moment, and finally we're here!
It is our pleasure to present you our game, Undercat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37759893/cc7ddbaddb6ecdae20b71eb370ff951d9dfe4041.gif[/img]

If you come across a bug or an issue, please contact us at [url=https://discord.gg/unJYSRQVh2 ]Discord UNDERCAT[/url]
Or create a discussion post on Steam. We'll make sure to look at it and fix it in the next update.

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Game release soon!
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone!

Welp...It's been a while since our last update! However, despite all the trials and tribulations, we're excited to announce that we're close to the finish line!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37759893/727a7c497441681211c0eff0b29ff7237ba464c9.gif[/img]

From today on, every couple of weeks, we'll be posting about our game's past, present, and future, each post signing a step closer to the game release!

Stay tuned for the updates! Thank you for your support!
